<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This file is a standard Arch Linux PKGBUILD .install script containing pre_remove() and post_remove() hooks for managing a user systemd service (skwd-walld.service). The _skwd_user_systemctl() helper iterates over user runtime directories and uses runuser to execute systemctl commands within each user's D-Bus session context — a legitimate pattern for user service management. The pre_remove() function gracefully stops the service via pkill with TERM then KILL, while post_remove() performs standard daemon-reload and reset-failed cleanup. No network requests, file exfiltration, obfuscation, or execution of untrusted code are present. All operations are confined to the package's own service scope.
</details>
